title: Why Penalties Are 12 Yards
coreQuestion: Why is the penalty spot 12 yards from goal?

facts.claim: William McCrum, from Milford, is credited with inventing the penalty kick.
The penalty kick was introduced in 1891.
At first the kick could be taken from any point 12 yards from the goal line.
John Heath of Wolverhampton Wanderers scored the first penalty in a match.

narration.text: Why is a penalty taken from 12 yards?
The idea came from William McCrum, a goalkeeper from Milford.
In 1891, football adopted the penalty kick.
At first it could be taken from anywhere 12 yards from the goal line.
John Heath of Wolverhampton Wanderers scored the first. Every goal has a story.
